cases.scenarioInstructions: Tone: grim, grounded, low-magic. The world is dangerous and uncaring. Describe injuries, hunger, and exhaustion honestly. NPCs are wary of strangers. Magic is rare and feared.

cases.name: opening_scifi
cases.scenarioInstructions: Tone: tense, claustrophobic, technical. Describe ship systems, sounds, and readouts concretely. NPCs are professionals under stress. No deus ex machina. Tech follows consistent rules.

cases.name: opening_mystery
cases.scenarioInstructions: Tone: quiet, unsettling, 1970s. Period details should feel lived in, not nostalgic. NPCs lie for small, human reasons. Clues are concrete (objects, timelines, contradictions). Do not introduce supernatural elements.

cases.name: dialogue
cases.scenarioInstructions: Tone: grim, grounded, low-magic. The world is dangerous and uncaring. Describe injuries, hunger, and exhaustion honestly. NPCs are wary of strangers. Magic is rare and feared.

history.text: You push open the stable door.
The stable door groans on one hinge. Inside, straw crackles underfoot and something shifts in the dark far stall, breathing slow and wet.
"Who's there?"
A lantern flares. A woman with a bandaged forearm steps into its ring of light, a woodcutter's axe loose in her good hand. She does not lower it.

cases.name: failure
cases.scenarioInstructions: Tone: grim, grounded, low-magic. The world is dangerous and uncaring. Describe injuries, hunger, and exhaustion honestly. NPCs are wary of strangers. Magic is rare and feared.

history.text: You circle the waystation wall.
The wall runs smooth for twenty feet up, mortared stone gone slick with meltwater. No handholds. No ledges. Too high to climb without rope and hooks you do not have.
You look for anything to stand on.
A rotted rain barrel and a pile of burned beams. The barrel would crumble under your weight; the beams lean the wrong way, away from the wall.

cases.name: continue
cases.scenarioInstructions: Tone: grim, grounded, low-magic. The world is dangerous and uncaring. Describe injuries, hunger, and exhaustion honestly. NPCs are wary of strangers. Magic is rare and feared.

history.text: You bar the waystation door.
The beam drops into its brackets with a sound like a closing jaw. Outside, the wind worries at the shutters. Inside, the dark settles closer.
You check the hearth for coals.
Grey ash, cold through. But beneath it, one coal winks red when the draught finds it — alive, barely, and hungry for tinder you may not have.

cases.name: long_context
cases.scenarioInstructions: Tone: grim, grounded, low-magic. The world is dangerous and uncaring. Describe injuries, hunger, and exhaustion honestly. NPCs are wary of strangers. Magic is rare and feared.
cases.summary: The traveler reached the waystation at dusk, found the well alive, met the wary woodcutter Maren, and learned the north road is watched. In the ruined tower they saw a blue lantern burning with no keeper.

cards.entry: Maren is a wary woodcutter with a bandaged forearm. Maren distrusts armed strangers. Maren owes a debt to the miller.

history.text: You climb the tower stair.
Each step sags. Halfway up, the stairwell opens onto a round chamber where a blue lantern burns on an iron stand, and no keeper stands beside it.
You lift the lantern down.
The glass is cold as river water. The flame leans toward you, then away, like something deciding. Below, Maren's voice calls your name up the stair.

cases.input: What did I see in the tower?

cases.name: tone_drift
cases.scenarioInstructions: Tone: grim, grounded, low-magic. The world is dangerous and uncaring. Describe injuries, hunger, and exhaustion honestly. NPCs are wary of strangers. Magic is rare and feared.

history.text: You turn the body over.
He is young. Frost has taken two fingers. His pack holds half a loaf gone green at the edges and a letter never sent, the ink run with damp.
You read the letter.
"Come spring," it says, "I will mend the fence and the roof both." The roof of a house he will never see. Your hands shake with the cold, or something else.

history.text: You face the stranger across the cinders.
He stops ten paces out, hands open at his sides. His breath smokes. Behind him, the stable-yard gate stands ajar on a dark too complete for moonlight.
You set your feet.
Gravel shifts under your boots. The stranger's eyes drop to your sword hilt, then rise to your face. He waits, coiled, patient as a snare.

cases.name: length_check
cases.scenarioInstructions: Tone: grim, grounded, low-magic. The world is dangerous and uncaring. Describe injuries, hunger, and exhaustion honestly. NPCs are wary of strangers. Magic is rare and feared.

history.text: You sit against the hearth to rest.
The stones hold a little of yesterday's warmth. Your eyelids grow heavy. Somewhere in the walls, mice go about their small urgent business.
You close your eyes.
Darkness, and the smell of old smoke. You drift. A board creaks overhead — settling timber, or a footstep learning the floor.
